what_changed.title: Gong launches Mission Callisto at Celebrate '26
what_changed.body: NEW vs yesterday. Sep 30 press + blog after virtual opening keynote: Mission Callisto adds Gong Enrich (third-party account/contact waterfall into Revenue Graph; partners incl. Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LeadIQ, etc.), Agent Builder for event-triggered Custom Agents (natural language or visual; reusable skills), Deep Mode in Gong Assistant (complex investigation; Gong Credits), expanded Gong Dashboards. Also announced Gong Activate — next-gen Revenue AI framing (self-improving “revenue loop”; agents + reps from same blueprint). GA now: Enrich, Deep Mode, Dashboards (Forecast users; broader later). Auto-triggered Custom Agents + other Assistant enhancements rolling later in 2026. Why it matters: confirmed Celebrate product drop — enrichment + agentic execution + measurement inside Revenue AI OS, not just event promo.

what_changed.title: Clay Skills Marketplace still live (Sep 29)
what_changed.body: RETAINED. Community GTM skills free to install into Claude Code / Codex / Cursor; Clay supplies data via Agent Plugin. Credits when skills pull Clay data. No net-new product PR Oct 1; marketplace remains the live distribution surface. Why it matters: shareable GTM skill layer on coding agents — ecosystem/distribution, not a classic AI SDR SKU.

what_changed.title: Salesforce signs definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs
what_changed.body: RETAINED (Sep 29). AI customer research + human simulation (study design, interviews, synthesis, digital twins). Close expected Q4 Salesforce FY2027 subject to conditions. Price undisclosed in official story. Why it matters: agentic research/simulation context for Agentforce-adjacent stack.

what_changed.body: NEW vs yesterday (Sep 30 X). Salesforce posts that it is now part of the OpenAI Marketplace — discover Agentforce and use part of existing OpenAI commitment toward eligible partner products. Why it matters: distribution/procurement path for Agentforce next to OpenAI enterprise spend (not a new Agentforce SKU).

market_briefing.lede: Revenue AI vendors are shipping the full loop — trusted context, agentic execution, and measurement — while GTM teams also get shareable “skills” that run inside coding agents on top of data planes. Buyer scrutiny of frontier models and agent controls is rising in parallel.

bullets.text: Platform move: Gong Mission Callisto (Enrich + Agent Builder + Deep Mode + Dashboards) and Gong Activate framing put enrichment, event-triggered agents, and analytics inside one Revenue AI OS.
